from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single court document found in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment or ruling document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or case nature text extracted from the document (e.g. '执行回转', '不动产登记纠纷', '行政诉讼')")
    procedural_nature: str | None = Field(description="The procedural category of the case (e.g. '执行', '民事', '行政'), as indicated in the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
